title: Cleaner local controls: presence rejected, observed donors, global appearance and FGT memory preflight
body: Executed local composition-only V1/V2 over archived LaMa B predictions; no new inference, paid jobs, production change or Golden mutation. V2 source PNG hashes verified,150 frames,1080x1920,30fps. Master has zero changed pixels outside alpha/selection,zero source PTS delta,and source/master/delivery audio bitstream hashes equal. Proposed support reduced68.95995%;16,324 unsupported pixels were excluded from applied alpha. REJECT for visible inherited patch and missed faded text,not a valid replacement for Golden. Donor diagnostics:4-nearby vs up-to12 candidates; additional manually inspected clean references0/1,77/78,145/146. Current affine consensus accepts25,766 candidate pixels for frame90 only; this is not pixel-level truth or restored-quality approval. Window and cloth alignment fail despite clean source observations. No donors were applied. Four global tone/sharpness controls completed over Golden; subtle appearance change,overshoot/clipping recorded,not neural upscale or VMake parity; no promotion. Static official FGT FP32 native-grid calculation estimates17.246GiB for peak attention score tensor before softmax/other buffers on target6GB GPU; no FGT inference or measured OOM. All statements apply to this clip and exact archived contracts. Six synthetic mask controls pass; browser runtime and blinded temporal review remain untested. Use linked reports and checkpoint rather than reread full history.
